highlight.text: Smoke billows across the scene, directing our attention to a figure, perhaps the nurse, in the distant house.

work.text: The scene portrayed generally illustrates the poem or the circumstances under which it was written, but sometimes there appears to be little or no connection between them, or else it is too subtly veiled for our understanding.

source.author: Basil Stewart

moment.text: Visual interpretations of poems from the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu had traditionally been formalised depictions of court life, or portraits of the poets themselves dressed in classical costume.

matters.text: Hitomaro wrote of an emotionally tiring night. The nurse thought instead of the physically exhausting work of fishermen dragging a net upstream.
